```cypher
MATCH (gps:Plugin {component: 'format_gps'})-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(category:Category)
MATCH (gps)-[:MAINTAINS]->(maintainer:Maintainer)
MATCH (alternative:Plugin)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(category)
WHERE alternative.component <> gps.component
OPTIONAL MATCH (alternative)-[:MAINTAINS]->(altMaintainer:Maintainer)
WITH alternative, COLLECT(DISTINCT altMaintainer.display_name) AS maintainers
RETURN alternative.component, alternative.name, maintainers
ORDER BY alternative.name
LIMIT 100
```
